evidence.title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks

summary: Researchers unveil LongWoF-Bench, a benchmark designed to assess AI models' ability to handle verifiable, multi-step workflows using EvoMap genes. The tool aims to improve reliability in complex, long-horizon decision-making systems.
title: LongWoF-Bench Introduces Framework for Evaluating AI in Long-Workflow Tasks
